lines.name: Sam
lines.en: Seoul Station. OK! Are you in a hurry?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I have to catch a train at ten a.m.

lines.name: Sam
lines.en: It's nine twenty now. It takes about thirty minutes. Don't worry, we'll make it! Where are you traveling to?
lines.ko: 지금 9시 20분이에요. 30분쯤 걸려요. 걱정 마세요, 제시간에 도착할 거예요! 어디로 여행 가세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'm going to Daegu to see one of my friends.

lines.name: Sam
lines.en: Daegu! That's nice. How long will you stay there?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'll stay there for two days at a hotel.

lines.name: Sam
lines.en: Two days. Sounds fun! Oh, there's a lot of traffic here. Do you mind if I take a different road?
lines.ko: 이틀이요. 재밌겠네요! 아, 여기 차가 많이 막히네요. 다른 길로 가도 괜찮을까요?

lines.name: Sam
lines.en: Thanks! This road is faster. Is your friend going to meet you at the station?
lines.ko: 감사합니다! 이 길이 더 빨라요. 친구분이 역으로 마중 나오세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, my friend will meet me at the station, and we're going to eat spicy braised short ribs.
lines.ko: 네, 친구가 역으로 나올 거고, 같이 매운 갈비찜을 먹으러 갈 거예요.

lines.name: Sam
lines.en: Good choice! Daegu is famous for spicy food. Here we are, Seoul Station. That's fifteen thousand won.
lines.ko: 잘 고르셨어요! 대구는 매운 음식으로 유명하죠. 다 왔습니다, 서울역이에요. 만 오천 원입니다.

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Thank you so much. I won't be late for my train because you took the faster road.
lines.ko: 정말 감사합니다. 빠른 길로 와 주셔서 기차 시간에 늦지 않겠어요.

lines.name: Sam
lines.en: You're welcome! Will you pay by card or cash?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: By card, please. Here is my card.

lines.name: Sam
lines.en: Thank you! Here's your card and receipt. Have a great trip, and enjoy the galbi-jjim!
lines.ko: 감사합니다! 카드랑 영수증 여기 있어요. 즐거운 여행 되시고, 갈비찜 맛있게 드세요!
